name: Takemura Yuusuke
source:
A fairly ordinary office worker, if a bit on the selfish and anti-social side. After society collapses, he embraces his inner nihilist and does whatever he pleases in the new world of survival of the fittest. For some reason, the zombies don't attack him. In fact, he is unique in that they ignore him completely.

He lost both his parents, and his surviving relative, his grandfather, passed away in a traffic accident two years earlier.

[From [url=https://denpasoft.com/products/i-walk-among-zombies]Denpasoft[/url]]
